checks_performed: Read the exact target and compared it directly with the draft's conclusion and claimed resolution.
Re-derived the WKE one-vertex reduction, hereditary induction, and locally bipartite specialization from their definitions.
Ran a fresh exact integer-bitmask census of all 4,682,270 labelled triangle-free graphs on eight vertices and literally validated a WKE witness for every graph.
Ran a separate exact checker on the nine-vertex C5 blow-up, testing all 512 vertex subsets and all 275 graph matchings against every admissible Q.
Audited triangle-edge pruning, triangle-overlap additivity, degeneracy and maximum-average-degree deductions, minimal-counterexample quantifiers, and the componentwise assembly.
Used no web access or evidentiary files other than the two authorized JSON inputs; only the required checker programs were created in the designated scratch directory.

claims.claim: A WKE link gives a self-contained one-vertex reduction.
claims.evidence: For a WKE witness (M,Q) in G[N(v)], the triangles vxy for xy∈M are edge-disjoint because M is a matching. Taking X=M∪{vq:q∈Q} gives |X|≤2|M|, hits every triangle through v, and removes every non-v edge of those packed triangles. A residual packing therefore combines with these |M| triangles, while X combines with a residual transversal. Thus τ(G')≤2ν(G') implies τ(G)≤2ν(G).
claims.search_method: Direct symbolic verification from the WKE, packing, and transversal definitions.

claims.claim: Every graph whose every nonempty subgraph has a vertex with WKE link satisfies τ≤2ν.
claims.evidence: Induct on vertex count. The WKE reduction at the guaranteed vertex produces a graph with fewer vertices. Every subgraph of that residual graph remains a subgraph of the original and hence retains the stated hypothesis. Induction and claim 0 complete the argument, including the empty residual case.
claims.search_method: Hereditary induction with explicit verification of the residual hypothesis.

claims.claim: Every locally bipartite graph satisfies τ≤2ν.
claims.evidence: Local bipartiteness is inherited by arbitrary subgraphs. For a finite bipartite link with bipartition A,B, the alternating-path proof of König's theorem gives a maximum matching M and a vertex cover Q of equal size: if Z is reachable from unmatched vertices of A by alternating paths, take Q=(A\Z)∪(B∩Z). Hence the link is WKE. Claim 1 then applies.
claims.search_method: Direct hereditary argument plus the alternating-path matching-cover construction.

claims.claim: Every triangle-free graph on at most eight vertices is WKE.
claims.evidence: The exact checker generated each labelled order-eight triangle-free graph uniquely by adjoining the final vertex with every independent prior neighborhood. It generated 4,682,270 graphs. For every graph it found matching M and Q and independently checked M⊆E(H), that M is a matching, |Q|≤|M|, and that Q covers H−M. All 4,682,270 passed. Smaller orders follow by padding with isolates to order eight and then removing isolates from Q.
claims.search_method: Complete labelled generation and exhaustive integer-bitmask WKE-witness search; no floating point, randomness, solver, or external data.
claims.witness: The checker reproducibly constructs and literally validates one (M,Q) witness for each of the 4,682,270 generated order-eight graphs.

claims.claim: The order-eight WKE bound is sharp: a triangle-free non-WKE graph exists on nine vertices.
claims.evidence: The checker constructed the stated 16-edge C5 blow-up and verified it is triangle-free. Among all 512 vertex subsets, the largest inducing maximum degree at most one has size four. Independently, it enumerated all 275 matchings of the graph and every Q with |Q|≤|M|; none covered H−M. Thus no WKE witness exists.
claims.search_method: Direct exhaustive integer-bitmask enumeration of triangles, vertex subsets, graph matchings, and admissible Q.
claims.witness: Vertices are partitioned as A0={0}, A1={1,2}, A2={3,4}, A3={5,6}, A4={7,8}; each Ai is independent and all possible edges join Ai to A(i+1 mod 5), with no other edges.

claims.claim: Deleting every edge that lies in no triangle preserves both ν and τ.
claims.evidence: The original graph and its triangle-edge subgraph have exactly the same triangle family. Hence their feasible packings coincide. An edge outside every triangle cannot help hit any triangle, so deleting such edges also leaves the minimum transversal size unchanged.
claims.search_method: Direct comparison of triangle families and feasible packing/transversal sets.

claims.claim: Triangle packing and covering are additive over triangle edge-overlap components.
claims.evidence: Supports of distinct overlap classes have disjoint edge sets; otherwise two class triangles would share the common support edge through a chain and belong to the same class. Packings from the classes therefore combine, and every global packing partitions by class. Likewise, a global transversal restricts to a transversal of each class, while the union of class-optimal transversals is global. Both optima are consequently sums of the class optima.
claims.search_method: Direct decomposition proof in the triangle edge-overlap equivalence relation.

claims.claim: If the triangle-edge subgraph G△ is K4-free and 8-degenerate, then τ(G)≤2ν(G).
claims.evidence: Every nonempty subgraph J of G△ has a vertex v of degree at most eight. Its link is triangle-free, since a link triangle together with v would form K4, and is WKE by claim 3. Thus G△ satisfies claim 1's hereditary elimination hypothesis. Claim 5 then transfers τ≤2ν from G△ to G.
claims.search_method: Degeneracy elimination using the independently checked small-link lemma.

claims.claim: If G△ is K4-free and mad(G△)<9, then τ(G)≤2ν(G).
claims.evidence: Every nonempty subgraph has average degree below nine, so it has an integer degree at most eight. Therefore G△ is 8-degenerate, and claim 7 applies with the assumed K4-freeness.

claims.claim: A subgraph-minimal K4-free counterexample would have every edge in a triangle and minimum degree at least nine.
claims.evidence: A non-triangle edge could be removed without changing ν or τ by claim 5, contradicting subgraph minimality. If d(v)≤8, K4-freeness makes its at-most-eight-vertex link triangle-free and hence WKE. Claim 0 reduces to a proper subgraph, which satisfies the inequality by minimality, again a contradiction. Thus every edge is triangular and δ≥9.
claims.search_method: Minimal-counterexample contradictions using edge pruning and WKE vertex reduction.

claims.claim: The inequality holds componentwise whenever every triangle edge-overlap component has either a locally bipartite structure or a K4-free 8-degenerate structure.
claims.evidence: Claims 2 and 7 prove τ≤2ν for the two permitted types of support component. Applying the appropriate result independently to every triangle overlap component and summing with claim 6 proves the global inequality; non-triangle edges are irrelevant by claim 5.
claims.search_method: Componentwise assembly of the two verified subclass theorems.

target_evidence: The exact target requires either a proof of τ(G)≤2ν(G) for every finite simple graph or an explicit rigorously proved counterexample. The draft expressly says that the unrestricted conjecture remains unresolved and supplies no counterexample, so it does not fully resolve the target. It does establish correct, material subclasses—most notably K4-free, 8-degenerate triangle-edge subgraphs, the mad<9 consequence, locally bipartite graphs, and mixtures over triangle overlap components—so VALID_PARTIAL_PROGRESS is warranted rather than NO_VALID_PROGRESS. Its claimed_resolution is PARTIAL and its final writeup explicitly disclaims universal coverage; that resolution claim is therefore ACCURATE, not overstated or understated.
